vendoring.rationale: Preserve the locked runtime implementation, licenses, native registrations and declared runtime assets. Migrate public UI-library ownership and explicitly typed contracts; record local source API/style and deprecated-API changes individually below. No private Flutter SDK imports, compatibility facade, added analyzer ignores or relaxed gates.

changes: Replace the public legacy Material import with package:material_ui/material_ui.dart; preserve widget logic and public signatures.
Accept optional Widget keys; use typed Dart 3.12 private-field initializing formals while retaining the public ratingWidget/itemBuilder argument names and their non-null types.

Return State<RatingBar> without exposing its private implementation; make immutable helper constructors const, rename local variables and order child arguments last without altering rating calculations.
Replace Matrix4.scale(-1, 1, 1) with scaleByDouble(-1, 1, 1, 1), preserving the horizontal reflection including its homogeneous coordinate.
Replace the public legacy Material import with package:material_ui/material_ui.dart; preserve widget logic and public signatures.
Make the immutable constructor const with an optional Widget key; expose State<RatingBarIndicator> while retaining its private implementation.
Replace deprecated Matrix4.scale with the equivalent scaleByDouble(-1, 1, 1, 1) reflection.
Mark the application-owned source copy publish_to: none.
Declare the Dart >=3.13 and Flutter >=3.47 minimum required by the selected public UI packages.
Declare material_ui ^1.11.0 as a direct runtime dependency.
